earlierPinSelectionRun.reason: Final rerun additionally pins unchanged js/lcd.js, the source loaded by existing touch checks; no product code changed between runs.

layoutReview.widthEstimateBoundary: CSS arithmetic using existing padding/gaps and no safe-area inset. Actual glyph widths and visible button groups require the controlled browser preview; this audit does not assign a universal minimum supported viewport.

risks.evidence: m.html reloadLCD reads hd-mobile-stage once at postRun and on window/orientation/visualViewport resize, with no ResizeObserver. HUD show/hide changes header and stage height even without those events.
risks.impact: Classic MAP can have a visible HUD; the LCD can retain previous dimensions/centering after header height changes.
risks.suggestion: Observe stage size with a read-only ResizeObserver and call existing reloadLCD, or otherwise explicitly reflow that existing function on actual stage dimensions. Do not synthesize global resize or native input.

risks.evidence: Existing @media orientation:portrait hides #hd-mobile-bar. A later max-width900 #hd-mobile-bar display:grid rule at equal specificity can unhide it.
risks.suggestion: Constrain the new grid rule to landscape or keep portrait hiding after it.

risks.evidence: Defining two explicit grid rows or two template-area rows can retain a row gap when HUD has display:none.
risks.suggestion: Set HUD grid-row:2 / grid-column:1 / -1 but keep rows implicit; retain #hud[hidden] display:none.

risks.evidence: Minimum 44px buttons and 4px gaps remain. Map normally has six visible controls; battle retains disabled map controls plus battle toggle.
risks.suggestion: Do not claim arbitrary tiny landscape widths. Verify normal and maximal visible control states at 667 and 844, then let status shrink safely; ensure first-row status does not force a third row.

controlledPreview.automation: Bundled Playwright launching one task-owned installed Chrome persistent context over own pipe
controlledPreview.boundary: Production m.html DOM/CSS, four production HUD/map/portrait scripts; classic geometry additionally loads production jQuery and unchanged m.html inline LCD definitions with Module={} and guarded postRun (not executed), real existing HD PNG, explicit mock original identity and deep read-only world. Shared overworld rendering is a labeled controlled diagram; HUD-hidden battle-header presentation is a DOM-only stub. No engine/main/WASM/real LIB/natural play/physical device/full-HD acceptance. Old CSS negative uses committed parent m.html DOM and parent CSS without executing new observer; no product files replaced. Classic HUD transitions select among prebuilt immutable fixture snapshots; no existing native world is mutated.
controlledPreview.processBoundary: One new owned Chrome persistent context with retained isolated profile; all owned pages and context closed, private HTTP closed. No existing browser, game, CDP endpoint, 8080 or process inventory accessed.

visualReview.method: All 10 saved PNG paths individually opened with tools.view_image; RO/MO matching states additionally have identical screenshot SHA.
notes: Both exact MAP viewports visibly show all six maximum HUD values, including original four-character name, full 65535年12月 and three 65535 values; true HD portrait and map remain separate.
The HUD-hidden battle-header presentation keeps a 52px bar and six 44px header controls. This is a controlled DOM presentation, not a running battle.
Parent DOM/CSS negative screenshot visibly truncates owner/date/three resource values, matching scrollWidth measurements; it never loads the new observer inline.

Classic LCD fits the remaining stage at both 52px and 89px header heights with 160:96 ratio, in RO and forced MO fallback paths; hidden/restored pictures and RO/MO corresponding pictures match exactly.
